```{r setup, include = FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, results = "hide", message = FALSE,
                      warning = FALSE,
                      fig.align = "center")
```

This document regenerates Figures 1 and 3 of the manuscript from saved BRACE outputs; the
MCMC sampler is not re-run. Knit it from the folder that contains it. That folder also holds
the three input files:

- `Demmer_phyloseq_processed.rds`: processed ORIGINS data (phyloseq object with 111 samples,
  130 species and the phylogenetic tree).
- `continuous_spearman_screening_relative_abundance.csv`: Spearman correlations between
  species relative abundances and fasting insulin.
- `Pseudocount_0.5_postSALSO_K7_results_2chain.Rdata`: BRACE posterior output (2 chains)
  after SALSO partition estimation and cluster-conditional resampling of the cluster effects.

Each figure is also saved as a PDF file in `Figures/`. The complete code is listed in the
Appendix.

```{r libraries}
library(phyloseq)
library(ape)
library(ggtree)
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggtext)
library(reshape2)
library(patchwork)

dir.create("Figures", showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r helpers}
## Display labels for taxa: species name if informative, otherwise "Genus sp.",
## otherwise the lowest informative higher rank.
make_tax_label_vec <- function(pseq,
                               ranks = c("Species", "Genus", "Family", "Order",
                                         "Class", "Phylum", "Domain", "Kingdom"),
                               fallback = c("short_id", "taxa_id"),
                               add_rank_suffix = FALSE,
                               genus_sp_when_species_bad = TRUE) {
  fallback <- match.arg(fallback)
  tax_mat <- as.data.frame(tax_table(pseq), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  tax_mat$taxa_id <- taxa_names(pseq)
  for (nm in c("Species", "Genus", "Family", "Order", "Class", "Phylum", "Domain",
               "Kingdom"))
    if (!nm %in% colnames(tax_mat)) tax_mat[[nm]] <- NA_character_
  ranks <- intersect(ranks, colnames(tax_mat))
  cand_ranks <- setdiff(ranks, c("Species", "Genus"))
  clean_tax <- function(x) {
    x <- as.character(x)
    x <- str_replace(x, "^D_\\d+__", "")
    x <- str_replace(x, "^[a-z]__", "")
    x <- str_replace_all(x, "_", " ")
    str_squish(x)
  }
  strip_trailing_bacterium <- function(x) {
    x <- str_squish(as.character(x))
    str_squish(str_replace(x, regex("\\bbacterium\\b\\s*$", ignore_case = TRUE), ""))
  }
  bad_core <-
    regex("uncultured|unclassified|unknown|unidentified|unassigned|metagenome",
          ignore_case = TRUE)
  is_bad_species <- function(x) {
    x <- str_squish(as.character(x))
    is.na(x) || x == "" || str_detect(x, bad_core) ||
      str_detect(x, regex("^sp\\.?$|\\bsp\\.?$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ||
      str_detect(x, regex("\\bbacterium\\b", ignore_case = TRUE))
  }
  is_bad_nonspecies <- function(x) {
    x <- str_squish(as.character(x))
    is.na(x) || x == "" || str_detect(x, bad_core) ||
      str_detect(x, regex("^sp\\.?$|\\bsp\\.?$", ignore_case = TRUE)) ||
      x %in% c("bacterium", "Bacterium")
  }
  tax_df <- tax_mat %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(ranks), clean_tax)) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(setdiff(ranks, "Species")), strip_trailing_bacterium)) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(
      fallback_label = if (fallback == "short_id") {
        str_replace_all(substring(taxa_id, 4), "_", " ")
      } else {
        str_replace_all(taxa_id, "_", " ")
      },
      tax_label = {
        sp <- Species; gen <- Genus
        if (!is_bad_species(sp)) {
          lbl <- sp; if (add_rank_suffix) lbl <- paste0(lbl, " (Species)"); lbl
        } else if (genus_sp_when_species_bad && !is_bad_nonspecies(gen)) {
          lbl <- paste0(gen, " sp.")
          if (add_rank_suffix) lbl <- paste0(lbl, " (Genus)")
          lbl
        } else {
          vals <- if (length(.env$cand_ranks) > 0) {
            c_across(all_of(.env$cand_ranks))
          } else {
            character(0)
          }
          if (length(vals) == 0) fallback_label else {
            bad <- vapply(vals, is_bad_nonspecies, logical(1))
            vals[bad] <- NA_character_; vals[vals == ""] <- NA_character_
            idx <- which(!is.na(vals))[1]
            if (!is.na(idx)) {
              lbl <- vals[idx]
              if (add_rank_suffix) lbl <- paste0(lbl, " (", .env$cand_ranks[idx], ")")
              lbl
            } else fallback_label
          }
        }
      }
    ) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    select(taxa_id, tax_label)
  setNames(tax_df$tax_label, tax_df$taxa_id)
}

## Canonical taxon key used for joining (display labels are not unique)
canon_taxon <- function(x) {
  x <- as.character(x)
  x <- str_squish(x)
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "\\.+$", "")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "[.]", "_")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "__+", "__")
  x <- str_replace_all(x, "_+", "_")
  x
}
```

```{r data}
pseq <- readRDS("Demmer_phyloseq_processed.rds")
pseq_rank     <- tax_glom(pseq, taxrank = "Species", NArm = FALSE)
pseq_rank_rel <- transform_sample_counts(pseq_rank, function(x) x / sum(x))

screen_cont_results <- read.csv("continuous_spearman_screening_relative_abundance.csv",
                                stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

load("Pseudocount_0.5_postSALSO_K7_results_2chain.Rdata")
```

\clearpage
# Figure 1

```{r fig1-data}
tax_label_vec <- make_tax_label_vec(pseq_rank_rel, fallback = "short_id",
                                    add_rank_suffix = FALSE)
tax_map <- tibble(
  taxon       = names(tax_label_vec),
  taxon_key   = canon_taxon(taxon),
  taxon_label = unname(tax_label_vec)
) %>%
  distinct(taxon_key, .keep_all = TRUE)

assoc <- screen_cont_results %>%
  filter(!is.na(rho), !is.na(z_value), !is.na(p_value)) %>%
  mutate(
    direction = if_else(rho > 0, "Pos with insulin", "Neg with insulin"),
    taxon_key = canon_taxon(taxon)
  ) %>%
  left_join(tax_map %>% select(taxon_key, taxon_label), by = "taxon_key")

top20 <- bind_rows(
  assoc %>% filter(rho > 0) %>% arrange(desc(rho)) %>% slice_head(n = 10),
  assoc %>% filter(rho < 0) %>% arrange(rho)       %>% slice_head(n = 10)
) %>%
  distinct(taxon, .keep_all = TRUE)

## Match on the taxon key, not the display label: labels such as "Leptotrichia sp."
## are shared by several taxa.
assoc <- assoc %>% mutate(is_top20 = taxon_key %in% canon_taxon(top20$taxon))

rho_vec   <- setNames(assoc$rho, assoc$taxon)
tree_full <- phy_tree(pseq)
shared    <- intersect(names(rho_vec), tree_full$tip.label)
tree_full <- drop.tip(tree_full, setdiff(tree_full$tip.label, shared))
tree_full <- ladderize(tree_full)
rho_vec   <- rho_vec[tree_full$tip.label]
```

```{r fig1, fig.width = 15, fig.height = 7.5, out.width = "7.3in", out.extra = "angle=90"}
## Panel A: top 10 positive and top 10 negative correlations
bar_df <- assoc %>%
  filter(is_top20) %>%
  select(taxon, taxon_label, rho, p_value) %>%
  arrange(rho) %>%
  mutate(
    direction   = if_else(rho > 0, "Positive", "Negative"),
    significant = p_value < 0.10,
    taxon_label = factor(taxon_label, levels = taxon_label),
    sig_x       = if_else(rho > 0, rho + 0.009, rho - 0.009)
  )
stopifnot(nrow(bar_df) == 20, sum(bar_df$rho > 0) == 10, sum(bar_df$rho < 0) == 10)

p_hits <- ggplot(bar_df, aes(x = rho, y = taxon_label, fill = direction)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey40",
             linewidth = 0.55) +
  geom_col(width = 0.58, color = "grey25", linewidth = 0.30) +
  geom_point(data = bar_df %>% filter(significant),
             aes(x = sig_x, y = taxon_label, shape = "Marginal p-value < 0.10"),
             inherit.aes = FALSE, fill = "white", color = "black",
             stroke = 0.8, size = 3) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Negative" = "#0072B2", "Positive" = "#D55E00")) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("Marginal p-value < 0.10" = 21), name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-0.2, 0.2, by = 0.1), limits = c(-0.235, 0.255),
                     expand = expansion(mult = c(0.01, 0.01))) +
  labs(x = expression("Spearman correlation (" * rho * ")"), y = NULL, tag = "A") +
  guides(fill = "none",
         shape = guide_legend(override.aes = list(fill = "white", color = "black",
                                                  size = 3, stroke = 0.8))) +
  theme_classic(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.text.x  = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y  = element_text(size = 11, color = "black"),
    axis.ticks   = element_line(color = "black", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey90", linewidth = 0.4),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor   = element_blank(),
    legend.position = "bottom", legend.justification = "left", legend.box.just = "left",
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10.5),
    plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 15, 8, 10)
  )

## Panel B: phylogenetic tree, tips coloured by rho, same 20 species labelled
full_tip_df <- tibble(
  label       = tree_full$tip.label,
  rho         = rho_vec[tree_full$tip.label],
  direction   = if_else(rho > 0, "Pos with insulin", "Neg with insulin"),
  taxon_clean = label %>%
    sub("^s__", "", .) %>% sub("\\.$", "", .) %>% gsub("_", " ", .),
  is_top20    = label %in% top20$taxon
) %>%
  mutate(taxon_key = canon_taxon(label))

lookup <- tax_map %>% distinct(taxon_key, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  { setNames(.$taxon_label, .$taxon_key) }
full_tip_df <- full_tip_df %>%
  mutate(taxon_clean = if_else(is_top20 & !is.na(lookup[taxon_key]),
                               unname(lookup[taxon_key]), taxon_clean))

p_tree <- ggtree(tree_full, layout = "circular", size = 0.3) %<+% full_tip_df +
  geom_tippoint(aes(colour = rho), size = 1.2, alpha = 0.8) +
  geom_tiplab2(data = . %>% filter(isTip & is_top20),
               aes(label = taxon_clean, colour = rho),
               size = 3.2, offset = 0.005, hjust = 0) +
  scale_colour_gradient2(low = "#0072B2", mid = "grey80", high = "#D55E00",
                         midpoint = 0, name = expression(rho)) +
  labs(tag = "B") +
  theme(legend.position = "right",
        legend.title = element_text(size = 10), legend.text = element_text(size = 8),
        plot.tag = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16),
        plot.margin = margin(0, 10, 0, 0))

fig1 <- (p_hits | p_tree) + plot_layout(widths = c(1, 1))
fig1
ggsave("Figures/Figure1.pdf", fig1, width = 15, height = 7.5)
```

**Fig. 1.** Species-level associations with fasting insulin are not phylogenetically structured. (A) Spearman correlations between taxa relative abundances and insulin levels for the 10 most positively and 10 most negatively correlated taxa. Bar length represents the magnitude and direction of Spearman's $\rho$; open circles indicate marginal p-values < 0.10. (B) Phylogenetic tree labeled for the same 20 species, with tip colors indicating direction of association. Closely related taxa frequently display opposing associations, for example, *Selenomonas artemidis* (positive) and *Selenomonas* sp. (negative) are phylogenetic neighbors yet fall on opposite sides of the association spectrum.


\clearpage

# Figure 3

**Fig. 3.** Post-SALSO constrained resampling summary for BRACE-selected features. Panels (A)–(D) are shown on the following pages.

```{r fig3-setup}
tax_label_vec <- make_tax_label_vec(pseq, fallback = "short_id",
                                    add_rank_suffix = FALSE)
cluster_palette <- c(
  "1" = "blue",    "2" = "green",   "3" = "#1f77b4",
  "4" = "#ff7f0e", "5" = "#d62728", "6" = "#9467bd",
  "7" = "#8c564b", "8" = "#e377c2"
)
cl_indicators <- Z_fixed[selected_indices_cl]
cl_relabelled <- as.integer(factor(cl_indicators))
```

## Panel A

```{r fig3a, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 4, out.width = "90%"}
df <- tibble(
  Method    = c("CLR-Lasso", "C-Lasso", "Coda-Lasso", "BAZE", "BRACE", "BCGLM"),
  NVar_mean = c(11.37, 1.10, 15.83, 8.21, 10.00, 0.00),
  NVar_sd   = c(15.61, 1.06, 15.85, 3.69, 3.20, 0.00),
  PE_mean   = c(0.4127, 0.3999, 0.4512, 0.5786, 0.2199, 0.4023),
  PE_sd     = c(0.0732, 0.0704, 0.0835, 0.1464, 0.0587, 0.0723)
)
method_order <- df %>% arrange(PE_mean) %>% pull(Method) %>% rev()
df <- df %>% mutate(Method = factor(Method, levels = method_order))

plot_df <- bind_rows(
  df %>% transmute(Method, Metric = "Prediction error (PE)",        Mean = PE_mean,
                   SD = PE_sd),
  df %>% transmute(Method, Metric = "Number of selected variables", Mean = NVar_mean,
                   SD = NVar_sd)
) %>%
  mutate(xmin = pmax(Mean - SD, 0), xmax = Mean + SD)

method_cols <- c("CLR-Lasso" = "#7F7F7F", "C-Lasso" = "#E69F00",
                 "Coda-Lasso" = "#009E73",
                 "BAZE" = "#CC79A7", "BRACE" = "#0072B2", "BCGLM" = "#D55E00")

fig3a <- ggplot(plot_df, aes(y = Method, x = Mean, fill = Method)) +
  facet_wrap(~ Metric, scales = "free_x", nrow = 1) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = xmin, xend = xmax, y = Method, yend = Method, color = Method),
               linewidth = 1.1, lineend = "round") +
  geom_segment(aes(x = xmin, xend = xmin, y = as.numeric(Method) - 0.12,
                   yend = as.numeric(Method) + 0.12, color = Method),
               linewidth = 0.8, inherit.aes = FALSE, data = plot_df) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = xmax, xend = xmax, y = as.numeric(Method) - 0.12,
                   yend = as.numeric(Method) + 0.12, color = Method),
               linewidth = 0.8, inherit.aes = FALSE, data = plot_df) +
  geom_point(aes(color = Method), size = 3.6) +
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_df, Method == "BRACE"),
             shape = 21, fill = "white", color = "black", size = 4.8, stroke = 0.8) +
  geom_point(data = subset(plot_df, Method == "BRACE"), aes(color = Method),
             size = 3.6) +
  scale_color_manual(values = method_cols) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = method_cols) +
  labs(x = "Mean ± SD", y = NULL, title = "") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    panel.grid.major.y = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_line(color = "grey85", linewidth = 0.4),
    strip.text  = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13),
    axis.text.y = element_text(color = "black", size = 12, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14, hjust = 0.5),
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 0.7),
    plot.margin = margin(10, 10, 10, 10)
  )
fig3a
ggsave("Figures/Figure3A.pdf", fig3a, width = 7, height = 4)
```

**Fig. 3 (A)** Comparison of competing methods in terms of sparsity and predictive performance. The left panel shows the mean number of selected variables, and the right panel shows the mean prediction error (PE), with horizontal error bars representing one standard deviation across 30 replicates.

\clearpage

## Panel B

```{r fig3b, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 6, out.width = "90%"}
plot_data_cl <- data.frame(
  lower.ci      = quantile_mat_cl[1, selected_indices_cl],
  estimate      = quantile_mat_cl[2, selected_indices_cl],
  upper.ci      = quantile_mat_cl[3, selected_indices_cl],
  Row_Names     = tax_label_vec[taxa_names(pseq)[selected_indices_cl]],
  cluster_names = as.factor(cl_relabelled),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
plot_data_cl <- plot_data_cl %>%
  mutate(sign = ifelse(estimate < 0, "Negative", "Positive")) %>%
  arrange(sign, ifelse(sign == "Negative", -abs(estimate), abs(estimate)))
plot_data_cl$Row_Names <- factor(plot_data_cl$Row_Names,
                                 levels = plot_data_cl$Row_Names)

fig3b <- ggplot(plot_data_cl, aes(x = Row_Names, y = estimate,
                                  color = cluster_names)) +
  geom_segment(aes(xend = Row_Names, y = lower.ci, yend = upper.ci),
               linewidth = 0.5) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, color = "black", linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = cluster_palette) +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = -Inf, ymax = 0, alpha = 0.2,
           fill = "lightblue") +
  annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = 0, ymax = Inf, alpha = 0.2,
           fill = "lightpink") +
  annotate("text", x = 5, y = max(plot_data_cl$upper.ci) - 0.03, label = "High Risk",
           fontface = "bold", hjust = 1.1, size = 5, color = "magenta") +
  annotate("text", x = nrow(plot_data_cl) - 2, y = min(plot_data_cl$lower.ci) + 0.03,
           label = "Low Risk", fontface = "bold", hjust = 0, size = 5, color = "blue") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(x = "", y = "Coefficient Estimate", color = "Cluster") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "none",
    axis.text  = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid = element_blank(),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = "black")
  )
fig3b
ggsave("Figures/Figure3B.pdf", fig3b, width = 8, height = 6)
```

**Fig. 3 (B)** Posterior point estimates and corresponding credible intervals for features selected by BRACE in the post-SALSO constrained resampling analysis. Point colours indicate SALSO-estimated cluster membership.

## Panel D

```{r fig3d, fig.width = 5, fig.height = 4, out.width = "65%"}
calculate_correlation_statistics <- function(correlation_matrix, cluster_labels) {
  cl_vals <- sort(unique(cluster_labels))
  K <- length(cl_vals)
  within  <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, K), paste0("C", cl_vals))
  between <- matrix(NA_real_, K, K,
                    dimnames = list(paste0("C", cl_vals), paste0("C", cl_vals)))
  for (ii in seq_along(cl_vals)) {
    idx_i <- which(cluster_labels == cl_vals[ii])
    if (length(idx_i) >= 2) {
      corr_i <- correlation_matrix[idx_i, idx_i, drop = FALSE]
      # off-diagonal pairs only
      within[ii] <- mean(corr_i[upper.tri(corr_i)], na.rm = TRUE)
    }
  }
  for (ii in seq_along(cl_vals)) for (jj in seq_along(cl_vals)) if (ii != jj) {
    idx_i <- which(cluster_labels == cl_vals[ii])
    idx_j <- which(cluster_labels == cl_vals[jj])
    between[ii, jj] <- mean(correlation_matrix[idx_i, idx_j, drop = FALSE], na.rm = TRUE)
  }
  list(within_cluster_correlations = within, between_cluster_correlations = between,
       cluster_values = cl_vals)
}

## Phylogenetic correlation matrix from the tree (shared branch length, standardised)
dist_mat_full      <- vcv(phy_tree(pseq), corr = TRUE)
dist_mat_sel_corr  <- dist_mat_full[selected_indices_cl, selected_indices_cl]
sel_cluster_labels <- cl_relabelled

## Non-singleton clusters, keeping the cluster IDs used in Panel B
cluster_sizes     <- table(sel_cluster_labels)
non_singleton_cls <- as.integer(names(cluster_sizes[cluster_sizes >= 2]))
keep        <- sel_cluster_labels %in% non_singleton_cls
dist_mat_ns <- dist_mat_sel_corr[keep, keep, drop = FALSE]
labels_ns   <- sel_cluster_labels[keep]

statistics_ns <- calculate_correlation_statistics(dist_mat_ns, labels_ns)
diag(statistics_ns$between_cluster_correlations) <-
  statistics_ns$within_cluster_correlations
round(statistics_ns$between_cluster_correlations, 2)

corr_table_ns <- statistics_ns$between_cluster_correlations
cl_ids_ns     <- statistics_ns$cluster_values
axis_labels_colored <- sapply(cl_ids_ns, function(cid)
  sprintf("<span style='color:%s;'><b>C%d</b></span>",
          cluster_palette[as.character(cid)], cid))
names(axis_labels_colored) <- paste0("C", cl_ids_ns)

melted_ns <- melt(corr_table_ns[nrow(corr_table_ns):1, , drop = FALSE])

fig3d <- ggplot(melted_ns, aes(Var2, Var1, fill = value)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = sprintf("%.2f", value)), size = 5, fontface = "bold") +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "red", limits = c(0.1, NA)) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = axis_labels_colored) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = axis_labels_colored) +
  labs(x = "Cluster", y = "Cluster", fill = "Correlation") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x  = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.y  = ggtext::element_markdown(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    axis.title   = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.text  = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )
fig3d
ggsave("Figures/Figure3D.pdf", fig3d, width = 5, height = 4)
```

**Fig. 3 (D)** Mean phylogenetic correlation matrix summarising within-cluster and between-cluster phylogenetic correlations among the selected features, aggregated according to the SALSO-derived clusters.
